app.name: D-pad
app.summary: Up, down, left, right and OK, with back, home, menu and guide beside them, each running the Home Assistant action you choose.
app.tile_example: Arrow keys round an OK key, with back, home, menu and guide in the corners
app.key_back_hint: The action of this key, such as remote.send_command command=BACK. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_up_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=UP. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_home_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=HOME. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_left_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=LEFT. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_ok_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=OK. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_right_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=RIGHT. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_menu_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=MENU, or script.turn_on script.open_menu to act on another entity. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_down_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=DOWN. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_guide_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=GUIDE. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
